exec(open('/workspace/tmp/bench_actual.py').read().split("t0=time.time(); ns=")[0])
print('costs negative count',sum(1 for a in arcs if a[4]<0))
# identify eligible arcs cost<0
neg=[i for i,a in enumerate(arcs) if a[4]<0]
print('first neg',neg[:10], [arcs[i] for i in neg[:3]])
ns=NetworkSimplex(K,arcs,f0)
ns.solve()
print('after obj',ns.objective(),'cost sum',sum(ns.cost[i]*ns.flow[i] for i in range(ns.E)))
pi=ns.potentials()
for i in neg[:10]:
 print('neg',i,ns.cost[i],ns.flow[i],ns.basic[i],ns.cost[i]+pi[ns.fr[i]]-pi[ns.to[i]])
# Check first basic/nonbasic neg stats
print('neg flows',sum(1 for i in neg if ns.flow[i]), 'basic neg',sum(ns.basic[i] for i in neg))
# calculate residual conditions count
viol=[]
for i in range(ns.E):
 rc=ns.cost[i]+pi[ns.fr[i]]-pi[ns.to[i]]
 if ns.flow[i]<ns.hi[i] and rc<0: viol.append((i,'fwd',rc,ns.flow[i],ns.basic[i]))
 if ns.flow[i]>ns.lo[i] and -rc<0: viol.append((i,'back',rc,ns.flow[i],ns.basic[i]))
print('viol',len(viol),viol[:10])
PY
